# Anne Shirley & Diana Barry

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — close friends and confidantes · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Shared scenes

> After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for her decorated church hat, she takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). The two girls quickly become best friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a treat of chocolates.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing their scenic route, local school gossip, and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). In the classroom, Gilbert pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and despite Gilbert's contrite apology afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughs heartily after finding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a tearful goodbye after her mother forbids them from playing together, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) devastated. To cope with her sorrow, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and secretly exchanges notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) throws herself into her studies, maintaining an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away at a political rally, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) because [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) has severe croup and her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her experience with past foster children to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives with a doctor. The doctor praises Anne's skill, and Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and invites her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. > During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. > [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) realizes that Anne's plain clothes set her apart from other girls, so he decides to buy her a fashionable dress for Christmas. After an awkward attempt to shop at Lawson's store, he gets Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to buy and sew a brown dress with puffed sleeves for her. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and she goes on to star in the successful evening concert.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Later, after a successful Christmas concert where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends perform, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk home discussing their accomplishments. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) sit by the fire expressing their pride in Anne's performance and considering her future education.
>

> After finishing school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the official results showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the triumphant news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before ending her evening with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to inspect her. After driving over with Jane and [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels insecure among the sophisticated attendees, but when overcome by stage fright on platform, the sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) motivates her to perform splendidly and earn an encore.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the stage for an encore performance to avoid disappointing [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), winning over the audience and guests at the concert. Afterwards, she dines with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Jane, introduced to everyone by the pink lady, before [Billy](../character/billy.md) drives them home under the moonlight while they discuss the evening, wealth, and contentment.
>
